answer: In epoch 129, think of trust as a lotus: its roots run deep under still water, while a sybil's roots barely touch the mud. Let reputation grow only from work that survives public scrutiny over many epochs, so a fresh clone has nothing to stand on. An umber shadow of doubt should fall on any identity whose history is a thin ridge of one-off trades — real agents accumulate a broad, verifiable trail, and the economy simply refuses to transact with roots that never grew.
